| Category = Chicken recipes
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 24 [[Cookbook:Chicken#Wing|chicken wings]], tips removed, cut in half at the joint
* 10 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Kansas City Barbecue Sauce|barbecue sauce]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] hickory-flavored [[Cookbook:Liquid Smoke|liquid smoke]]
* 2 ½ [[Cookbook:Quart|quarts]] [[Cookbook:Peanut Oil|peanut]] or [[Cookbook:Canola Oil|canola oil]]
* 3 tbs [[Cookbook:Hickory BBQ Rub|hickory-flavored seasoning]] 

== Procedure ==
#Combine sauce and liquid smoke. Set aside.
#Season chicken evenly with seasoning. Set aside.
#Heat oil to 350°F. Add chicken, and working in batches, [[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|deep fry]] for 10–12 minutes or golden brown, crisp, and cooked through to 165°F.
#Remove chicken and drain on a [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|cooling rack]].
#[[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] with sauce mixture. Serve warm with blue cheese dressing.
